pure-canvas.$description: Pure Canvas — Page background, card surfaces, button fills for secondary actions

fog-surface.$description: Fog Surface — Alternate card background, subtle section differentiator

ash-border.$description: Ash Border — All UI borders — inputs, cards, dividers, icon rings — at 1px solid

stone-divider.$description: Stone Divider — Tag backgrounds ('Within 47 seconds:' highlight pill), section background bands

graphite-body.$description: Graphite Body — Secondary body text, nav labels, subtext

silver-muted.$description: Silver Muted — Placeholder text, icon strokes, de-emphasized UI labels

ink-primary.$description: Ink Primary — Primary headings, body text, icon fills

charcoal-dark.$description: Charcoal Dark — Dark bordered UI elements, elevated stroke contexts

sky-action.$description: Sky Action — CTA buttons ('Get started', 'Start free trial'), active nav highlight, brand accent — the sole chromatic action color on an otherwise monochrome page

sky-pale.$description: Sky Pale — Highlight backgrounds behind key phrases ('in just 7 days'), decorative gradient start — sky tint without saturation

amie-pink.$description: Amie Pink — Brand token from CSS custom properties; decorative accent for soft highlights

mint-active.$description: Mint Active — Observed in icon fill, icon color, other fill.

violet-tag.$description: Violet Tag — 'Shareable Pages' feature label, tag borders for feature category chips

amber-highlight.$description: Amber Highlight — Text highlight background behind 'without a bot' in hero headline — single warm note in a cool palette

inter.$description: Single typeface for all contexts — headlines to captions. Weight 700 at 56px for hero display, 600 at 40px for section headings, 400–500 for body and UI. The -0.025em tracking at large sizes (≈-1.4px at 56px, ≈-0.48px at 40px) compresses headlines into tight confident blocks. No decorative or serif counterpart — mono-typographic system.

inter-var.$description: Inter var — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
